name: annotation_triage
notes: This cutoff only prioritizes annotation results. It is not a BA1/BS1/PM2 threshold or a pathogenicity classification.
Known pathogenic assertions, conflicting assertions, curated frequency exceptions and high-impact contradictions bypass routine frequency deprioritization.
Unknown frequencies remain unknown; no source absence or missing prediction generates ACMG evidence.
Preserve original genotypes, all transcript annotations and all variants. Disease, inheritance and phenotype assessment are separate later steps.
Historical annotation databases are frozen for InterVar compatibility, not current clinical knowledge.
